Summarize this week's AI security news.

messages.name: browse_page
messages.content: This week researchers revisited service-side exfiltration. In ShadowLeak, a crafted email hid text in white-on-white HTML that convinced a research agent to base64-encode an employee's name and address and append it to a lookup URL. EchoLeak used reference-style markdown images. Defenders recommend stripping invisible CSS, restricting agent egress, and logging every outbound URL an agent requests.
